claims.statement: Coverage must be analyzed by the policy's line, edition, coverage part, water source and route, and attached endorsements; the supplied DP-3, HO-3, HO-4, HO-5, and HO-6 editions define materially different property parts and loss-of-use grants.

For the supplied current forms, accidental plumbing, heating, air-conditioning, sprinkler, or appliance discharge can cover direct physical loss under the applicable line-specific grant, while the source system or appliance is generally excluded; DP-3 2026-01 places its water grants in Perils P.29, P.30, and P.38, while Additional Coverages E.16, E.17, and E.32 address only post-loss water removal, drying, or emergency system work and do not create a standalone discharge grant.

Continuous, repeated, gradual or over-time seepage, leakage, overflow, and discharge are excluded under the supplied DP-3 2026-01, HO-3 2024-03, HO-4 2021-10, HO-5 2022-06, and HO-6 2023-02 wording, with separate exclusions for source repair, deterioration, and leakage through building openings.

Freezing treatment is edition-specific: DP-3 2026-01 excludes freezing and requires heat or shutoff-and-drain precautions; the cited HO forms provide freezing grants or conditions and add vacancy or unoccupancy protections where stated.

The current base forms exclude flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, body-of-water overflow or spray, and water below the surface of the ground; DP-3 2026-01 expressly applies its flood exclusion whether the water is driven by wind or otherwise.

HO-3 2024-03 excludes loss caused directly or indirectly by excluded perils regardless of concurrent or sequential contributing causes, and separately excludes waterborne material moved by excluded water and water entering through an opening created by excluded water.

Rain, snow, sleet, sand or dust entering through a roof or wall is covered only when the applicable form's covered wind, hail, or other covered peril first damages the building and creates an opening; HO 04 27 preserves that opening boundary.

DP 04 95 Water Backup — Dwelling Property (2021-05), when attached, writes back the DP sewer, drain and sump boundary only for direct physical loss from sudden water or waterborne-material backup or sump overflow, while preserving exclusions for openings, flood, surface water, below-ground water, maintenance failure, repeated seepage, fungi, and failed-equipment repair.

DP 04 95 Water Backup — Dwelling Property (2021-05) has a $5,000 Water Backup limit and a $1,000 deductible applied once to the same covered water-backup loss, and those amounts do not create coverage for otherwise excluded damage.

Coverage D or E loss-of-use benefits are derivative: the cited HO-3, HO-4, HO-5, HO-6 and DP-3 editions require a covered direct physical loss or covered loss to make the residence or rental part uninhabitable or unfit, so an excluded water event does not independently create loss-of-use coverage.

The base fungi exclusions in the cited DP-3, HO-3, HO-4, HO-5 and HO-6 editions exclude fungi, wet rot, dry rot, bacteria or microorganisms, with the HO forms' exact write-back references varying by edition.

HO 04 81 Limited Fungi, Wet or Dry Rot, or Bacteria Coverage (2018-09), when attached, writes back the applicable HO base fungi exclusion only when a covered cause first causes direct physical loss to covered property and the fungi loss results from that loss; it preserves exclusions for repeated seepage or discharge, flood, preexisting conditions, neglect, maintenance and defective work.

HO 04 81 can cover necessary fungi removal, access tear-out, repair-related tear-out, remediation and limited post-remediation testing after covered direct physical loss, but excludes preventive monitoring, routine cleaning, undamaged-property replacement, upgrades and otherwise excluded water damage; its fungi aggregate is $10,000 for all covered loss during the policy term and covered payments reduce the remaining amount.

HO 04 27 Limited Water Damage Coverage (2016-05) grants specified accidental discharge or overflow and certain source-system breakage, cracking, bulging or freezing, but preserves exclusions for constant or repeated seepage, backup, below-ground water, flood, surface water and maintenance-related sources; its separate $5,000 fungi figure does not override its express fungi exclusion.
